metadata.title: Meet the Founder | Green Garden
metadata.description: Meet the person behind Green Garden — a personal story of growing, caring for, and sharing plants with others.

ownerHero.title: Plants have always been part of my story.
ownerHero.description: Green Garden started from a simple love for growing, caring for, and sharing plants with others.
ownerHero.imageAlt: Portrait of the Green Garden founder among indoor plants

ownerStory.introTitle: Meet the person behind Green Garden.
ownerStory.introDescription: I first fell in love with plants by watching them grow — slowly, patiently, and full of quiet wonder. That curiosity grew into a habit of learning what each plant needs, and a joy in helping friends find the right green companion for their homes.
ownerStory.introImageAlt: A calm plant corner with warm natural light
ownerStory.journeyTitle: From a love of plants to Green Garden.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph1: Green Garden began when I realized how many people wanted plants in their lives, but felt unsure where to start. Choosing a plant should feel inspiring, not overwhelming.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph2: I started carefully selecting healthy plants, learning their habits, and sharing practical guidance — so every home could feel a little more alive.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph3: Today, Green Garden is still guided by that same intention: help you find a plant that fits your space, your routine, and the way you want to live.
ownerStory.journeyImageAlt: Healthy nursery plants arranged in soft natural light

ownerPhilosophy.title: Every plant has a place where it can thrive.
ownerPhilosophy.description: I believe the best plant is not always the rarest or most beautiful one. It is the one that fits your space, your lifestyle, and the way you want to live.

healthyPlants.title: Healthy Plants
healthyPlants.description: Every plant should arrive healthy, carefully prepared, and ready to settle into its new home.

honestGuidance.title: Honest Guidance
honestGuidance.description: We recommend plants based on your space and routine, not simply what is trending.

growingTogether.title: Growing Together
growingTogether.description: Green Garden is here to help you become more confident in caring for your plants.

ownerNote.title: Thank you for growing with us.
ownerNote.description: Every order from Green Garden is more than a sale. It is another plant finding a new home and another person beginning or continuing their plant journey.
ownerNote.name: The Founder
ownerNote.imageAlt: Small portrait of the Green Garden founder
